name: codegraph
title_zh: 代码库先解析成图，架构问题不再翻源码
tagline_zh: 装一次，本地脚本把整个项目变成可查询的依赖图。问"谁调用了它""改动影响谁"，几秒出答案。

desc_en: Turn any codebase into a queryable knowledge graph so architecture and dependency questions are answered from the graph instead of by re-reading source files. why_zh: 把"读代码"变成"查图"：解析一次，之后所有架构问题都走小命令，不依赖 IDE 或云端，离线可用。
why_en: Turns "reading code" into "querying a graph": parse once, then answer architecture questions via small commands. Offline.
limit_zh: 只解析 Python/JS/TS 等静态可分析语言；动态特性（eval、元编程）会漏边。
limit_en: Only statically analyzable languages (Python/JS/TS etc.); dynamic features (eval, metaprogramming) miss edges. Output is graph.json +.
title_en: Parse codebase into a graph; answer architecture questions.
